# Rankwise

> Rankwise is a local-marketing agency for local service businesses in the Lower Mainland, BC, Canada. We work to win service businesses a top-3 Google Map Pack position in their city, tracked against a 90-day position target agreed in writing before month one. If we miss the agreed milestone, billing pauses until we hit it.

Rankwise works across local service categories (plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, landscapers, and other local trades). Published audit examples are currently concentrated in heating and cooling, where our published work started; the audit method is the same for every trade.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rankwise.ca/): what we do, pricing tiers, and the guarantee
- [Free audit booking](https://rankwise.ca/audit/): book a free 15-minute local search audit
- [Audit examples](https://rankwise.ca/audits/): real audits of Lower Mainland businesses, showing the method (not client results)
- [Rankwise Lab](https://rankwise.ca/lab/): market studies of how local businesses actually rank in the Metro Vancouver Map Pack
- [Blog](https://rankwise.ca/blog/): answers to common local-marketing questions for service businesses
- [About](https://rankwise.ca/about/): who runs Rankwise

## Facts

- Service area: Lower Mainland / Metro Vancouver, BC, Canada
- Contact: through the booking page at https://rankwise.ca/audit/
- Pricing: three monthly tiers, listed on the home page
- Rankwise does not sell ads management, website builds, or social media management as headline services
